name: MVGS_CS_RECOMMENDATION_USE_TYPE
title: MV-GenomSeq recommendation use type
description: Regulatory use type of an MTB systemic therapy recommendation outside a clinical trial (KDK OncologyPlan recommendedSystemicTherapies[].type). mii-cs-mtb-zulassungsstatus has only in-label/off-label/leitlinie and is bound only to prior therapies (DISCUSS-TD #16). The KDK value 'unknown' is not a code: the extension is omitted instead.

concept.definition: Use of a not (yet) approved medicinal product within a compassionate use programme.
Systemic therapy recommended for secondary prevention.
